classification.difficultyReason: Source Mastery question requiring a common height to be found before calculating the unknown base.

spec.description: Two unfilled adjacent parallelograms with horizontal bases, parallel sloping sides, separate area labels and a segmented base dimension.
spec.mathematics: Both regions have the same perpendicular height. Their areas are 32 cm² and 72 cm²; the right base is 9 cm and the left base is y.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown label are visible.

answer.worked:
The parallelograms share the same perpendicular height.
$$\begin{align*}A&=bh\\72&=9h\\h&=\frac{72}{9}\\h&=8\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
For the left parallelogram:
$$\begin{align*}32&=8y\\y&=\frac{32}{8}\\y&=4\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
